title: [SOA] Bound outbound reply retries
summary: Outbound replies in the Sales Order Agent now limit retry attempts to five per message, provide a manual retry action, and isolate failures to prevent blocking other messages.
key_points: Capped failed outbound reply attempts at five per message to prevent infinite retries
Suppresses exhausted replies without recurring telemetry when retry limit is reached
Added a Retry sending action that resets the attempt count for manual retry
Isolated individual reply failures so remaining messages continue processing
Added new Reply Attempt table to track retry history
quote: cap failed outbound reply attempts at five per message
